column1: # The public ENA read sets the two reference sets called differently, out of the 4,024 of the at-scale
# sweep, measured under the shipped k-mer copy threshold. This is the population behind every head-to-head
# figure on the wiki's "Validation at scale" page.
# submitted      the ENA submitter label, normalised to a binomial. "Brucella sp." means the submitter
#                named no species, so neither call can be judged right or wrong at species level.
# vsnp_*         what --reference-set vsnp called it, with the distance and shared hashes behind it
# extended_*     the same for the default extended set. It held 432 genomes when this was measured;
#                three partial genomes that no run matched have been removed since (GCA_040391195.1,
#                GCA_032085995.1, GCA_032104425.1), so the calls are those of the 429-genome set as well
# scripts/score_public_sweep.py derives the figures from this file.
